b1.ryoka_outruns_relc.news: A barefoot Human Runner raced Senior Guardsman Relc on the north road and left him far behind. The Watch will not let him forget it.

canon_ref.note: Same day as the healing. She then runs about thirty miles before the Horns pick her up (1.39R). Delta is a design value.

b1.ryoka_outruns_relc.summary: Leg healed, Ryoka cartwheels in joy and sets off north on foot, the Horns' wagon following. On the road a big Drake guard with a spear races her for show. He nearly keeps up in armour, then she speeds away. Relc gives up, stunned, and wonders if Erin knows her.

b1.erin_burns_shield_spider_nest.news: Black smoke rose over the Floodplains all afternoon. Someone set a Shield Spider nest on fire.

canon_ref.note: Same day as 1.35R: the Horns smell the smoke an hour after they leave. Gazi reads Erin as a Level 11 [Innkeeper] with [Lesser Strength].

b1.erin_burns_shield_spider_nest.summary: Erin goes exploring alone with a rock, a knife, a potion and a jar of acid. A Krakk tree bursts and cuts her cheek. A Shield Spider hunts her to a hidden nest pit. She beats it with bare hands, then burns the whole nest with the burst wood. She weeps for the young and calls herself a killer.
